description: Evaluate a one-shot CV revision used as the simple control condition against the multi-agent pipeline.

clarity.design_anchor: The one-shot task and expected CV output are explicit.
clarity.execution_anchor: The revised CV is clear and readable.

role_alignment.design_anchor: The design requests only a direct evidence-based CV revision.
role_alignment.execution_anchor: The output is a revised CV rather than commentary.

relevance_and_focus.design_anchor: The instruction focuses on the target job.
relevance_and_focus.execution_anchor: The revision emphasizes job-relevant verified experience.

internal_consistency.design_anchor: The one-shot rules do not conflict.
internal_consistency.execution_anchor: The revised CV is internally consistent.

grounding_and_evidence_discipline.execution_anchor: Every material claim remains supported by the frozen case.

completeness_and_coverage.design_anchor: The input and requested revision cover the full CV.
completeness_and_coverage.execution_anchor: The output addresses the material fit gaps.

usefulness_and_actionability.design_anchor: The output is intended for immediate application use.
usefulness_and_actionability.execution_anchor: The result is a usable target-specific CV.

uncertainty_calibration.execution_anchor: Unknowns and private experience are not overstated.
